task_name: ViCrop: training-free task-guided visual cropping for MLLMs
scientific_objective: Mitigate information loss caused by fixed-resolution CLIP-style vision encoders for fine-grained perception by extracting a task-conditioned ROI, zooming in, and integrating local detail with the global view.
named_method: ViCrop (Visual Cropping) - training-free, attention-guided ROI cropping for MLLMs
core_steps: Encode image and task text with a vision-language model (CLIP family).
Compute a text-conditioned relevancy / attention map over the image patches.
Localise an ROI bounding box from the relevancy map (threshold + connected components + margin).
Crop the image to the ROI and re-encode at the model's native resolution (zoom-in).
Integrate global and cropped predictions via score-level ensemble.
explicit_groups_or_conditions: demo2.png (greenhouse / tulips, small subject color question)
primary_metrics: Top-1 score on multiple-choice options via image-text similarity
Margin between correct option and best distractor
deliverables: outputs/ : per-demo predictions, relevancy maps, bbox JSON
report/images/ : data overview, relevancy heatmaps, crop overlays, baseline bar chart
